title: Matilda
author: Roald Dahl
summary: A small, brilliant girl who loves books is ignored by her crooked parents and bullied by a terrifying headmistress. She discovers she has a strange power and a kind teacher who sees her worth.
readIf: you want a funny, empowering story about a clever child beating bullies.
skipIf: you dislike cartoonishly cruel adults, even when played for laughs.

pairings.reason: Another Dahl story about a small child who finds an unlikely protector.
Another bookish child escaping a dull home for something special.
A clever, funny children's novel about a boy facing a cruel system.
